payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

fact.question: Is the edited image rendered throughout as a pencil drawing?
fact.present_when: Pencil-drawing treatment is visibly applied throughout the image, rather than being limited to isolated areas, and the image reads as a pencil drawing overall.
fact.absent_when: The image is clearly assessable and is not rendered throughout as a pencil drawing, including when treatment is absent or limited to only part of the image.
fact.unknown_when: The image is too unclear to determine whether pencil-drawing treatment covers the image overall.
